title: dua: Make Friends, Chat & Date
meta_description: dua.com is a dating app destined to help you find love and create relationships.
full_description: We are here to help people find their perfect match! To connect you with others, so you can make friends from the same community as you, no matter where you are, worldwide. With dua.com, you can chat, date & meet up in beautiful places, and create meaningful relationships!Our app is a new way to connect and match people in countries with the same community, where you can make friends with similar interests and long-lasting relationships.We have thousands of daily active users from around the world who are here to chat and date with each other from different cities like Zürich, Pristina, Berlin, New York, London, and anywhere around the world.-In our dating app, we have around 400,000 registered users.  👩🏼‍❤️‍👨🏻-Serious Dating: Over 1000 successful love stories. It all started on dua.com! 🤵🏻👰🏼-Connecting Communities: Our platform has users from 33 countries all over the world. 🌎Getting started on dua.com is easy! Choose your pictures, fill out your bio section, verify your account, and start liking!Ditch the one-size-fits-all applications, and connect with your community! Download the dua.com dating app and meet new people.DUA.COM FEATURES- ‘Fly’—Traveling? Change your location with just one click! ✈️- ‘InstaChat’—Once you verify your account, you can send a personalized message before matching. 💌- ‘Image Verification’—Verify your profile for added security! We love & reward users who have a verified profile! ✅- ‘Undo’—Mistakes happen, but they can now easily be fixed with our undo option! 🔄- ‘Video chats/Audio calls’—When the conversation is so good, it's easier to keep it going with a video call. ☎️- ‘Boost’—Your profile stands out in front of others.⚡COMING SOON- dua.biz: Have a business idea? Looking for a partner? Find potential investors & partners on dua.com!- dua.friends: Traveling to a new place? Or just looking for friends? Socialize with your community worldwide!dua.com is committed to bringing all its users the best connection platform.We also offer optional subscription packages with dua Premium.💎DUA PREMIUM 💎-Get more impressions on your profile, access the ‘Liked you’ ❤️ screen, get unlimited 'Flights', ✈️, 'Undo's', 🔄, 'Video chats/Audio calls', ☎️, get access to more 'InstaChats', 💌, Ad-Free dua.com experience, upload up to 6 photos, 📸, get one free 'Boost', ⚡️.  We offer monthly, 3-month, and 12-month subscriptions. Prices are displayed in the app. Payment will be charged to your Google account at confirmation of purchase.Your subscription will automatically renew itself unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.Your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to Payments & Subscriptions and then Subscription.
